actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT
    t.id,
    t.platform,
    t.external_profile_id,
    t.handle,
    t.status,
    to_char(t.created_at, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS created_fmt
FROM public.sl_monitored_targets t
WHERE t.tenant_id = (
    SELECT u.tenant_id
    FROM public.sl_users u
    WHERE lower(u.email) = lower({{appsmith.store.userEmail}})
      AND u.is_active = TRUE
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC;
